{"caption":"A VERA workflow diagram combines environment verification and agent–harness feedback loops with round-by-round evaluation charts.","description":"A composite workflow diagram with two line charts on the right. Across the top, the “Env. Synthesis” box shows an LLM and Docker producing a “black box”; “no replay” and a red X mark the route as “hard to verify.” A right-pointing arrow labeled “VERA” leads to a pipeline: an LLM, “Auto Rubrics” that split a “long horizon trajectory” into S1 80, S2 64, S3 30, …, Sx 72, an “Agent Judge” that checks context and workspace, and Docker “Re-Play.” Plus signs connect the stages. A green check and arrow lead to “Verified Env.”, depicted as ascending colored blocks, and another green check and arrow lead to “Scaling,” shown with rising bars and upward/scaling symbols.

The lower-left section, “VERA Co-Evolve Agent Training,” shows an LLM and blue agent-like icon feeding an “Agent” box along a path labeled “SFT cold start”; a second LLM/agent-icon path feeds a “Co-Evolved Agent” box. Both point right into “Benchmarking.” A note above says “* Driven by GPT-5.6-Sol with Codex.” Benchmarking contains a stage-split long-horizon trajectory (S1 80, S2 64, S3 30, …, Sx 72) and an “Agent Judge*” producing “stage-wise scores.” A downward arrow leads to “Attribution*,” containing “Domain-Shift Detector,” “LLM Report,” and “Harness Report.” The LLM Report points down to a “Verified Env.” trajectory with the “target stage” highlighted; the Harness Report points down to “Harness Evolving.” That green box lists “skill add,” “skill merge,” and “skill remove,” marked respectively by a green plus, a merge-like symbol, and a red removal icon, above “Harness Verifier*.” The green “LLM Evolving” box contains “Reward Verifier*,” “Stage-Wise Rollout,” and “Rubric-as-Rewards.” Labeled feedback paths “next-round data” and “next-round harness” loop back toward the evolving/training components; arrowheads show feedback traveling left and then upward. Asterisks mark the named judge/verifier/attribution components.

The upper-right chart has eval score on a 0–30 vertical scale and rounds R0–R5 on the horizontal axis. Its dashed green SFT baseline is about 10. The solid green VERA-CoWork-9B series starts at about 10, rises to 27 at R1, dips to 23 at R2, rises to 27 at R3 and 30 at R4, then falls to 27 at R5. Printed stage annotations are init at R0, S3 at R1, S4 at R2, S5 at R3 and R4, and S2 at R5; the R4 point is marked with a yellow star. A green plus and “early_stop” appear near R2; “stage_tracker” and “plan_tracker” labels and small icons appear near R4.

The lower-right chart has eval score on a 25–40 vertical scale and rounds R0–R5 on the horizontal axis. Its dashed red SFT baseline is about 34. The solid salmon VERA-Med-9B series is about 34 at R0, 35 at R1, 35.5 at R2, 28 at R3, 35 at R4, and 38 at R5. Printed annotations are init at R0, S3 at R1, S5 at R2 and R3, S2 at R4, and S3 at R5; the R5 point is marked with a yellow star. A green plus and “early_stop” appear near R1, a red icon and “hotline” near R4, and a “fallback” box has a left-pointing arrow toward the low R3 region. Chart values are estimated from the plotted positions; the annotations and axis labels are
